name: Star Arthur Densetsu II ~Ankoku Seiun~
original_name: スターアーサー伝説 Ⅱ ～暗黒星雲～
source:
The story picks up where part one ended. You obtain the legendary sword. A hologram of a two thousand year old wise man sends you to Orion with the newly obtained weapon and your adventures on the way there take the whole game time. 

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事承接第一部结局。你已经取得传说之剑，一位生活在2000年前的贤者留下全息影像，要求你带着这件新获得的武器前往猎户座。整部游戏将描绘你一路上经历的冒险。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
